newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex ADS earns upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex ADS earns upped.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co said on Wednesday it had raised its estimate of 1996 earnings per American Depositary Share (ADS) for Telefonos de Mexico, or Telmex, to $4.05 from $3.30.
-- In a analysis, Oppenheimer also said it was raising its earnings per ADS estimate for 1997 to $3.35 from $2.90.

--- "... The stabilization of the economy combined with tariff recovery and increasing volumes will help Telmex improve its financial performance, only a quarter before the Mexican telco sector starts opening for competition in January 1997," the report said.
-- Telmex was off 1/8 to 31-1/8 in mid-afternoon trade in New York.
